message.content: Based on the conversations documented, Li Hua expressed a desire to have sourdough bread and sweet pastries available at Hailey's Bakery's anniversary event. Specifically, Li Hua stated, "Oh, I love sourdough! Hope you have that! And maybe some sweet pastries too?" This indicates that Li Hua would like sourdough bread and sweet pastries to be part of the offerings at the event. Additionally, Li Hua mentioned that she might bring Wolfgang with her, suggesting that these items might appeal to Wolfgang as well. Therefore, it can be inferred that Li Hua wants sourdough bread and sweet pastries to be prominent features of the anniversary event at Hailey's Bakery.
